limitations.note: The rewrite aligned the prefix and suffix checks but used the window including the new input bit, moving detection one clock earlier than the intended check of the pre-edge shift register and adding an unnecessary startup counter.
The test updated its expected window with the incoming bit before checking the output, so even exhaustive pattern coverage validated the same incorrect clock timing as the rewrite.

limitations.note: The only knowledge-base entry concerned duplicate FSM state encodings and offered no guidance on aligning the two pattern checks.
